value_grammar.decimal: Finite decimal, optionally in scientific notation: an optional leading '-', digits with an optional '.', then an optional exponent 'e' or 'E' with an optional '+' or '-' and one or more digits. No leading '+', whitespace, hexadecimal, infinity, NaN, or trailing characters. The value must be finite and inside the option's documented range; the decimal point is '.' in every locale. Conversion overflow, subnormal results and nonzero magnitudes rounded to zero are rejected; signed zero is admitted.
value_grammar.window: Decimal digits only; odd integer in [3,4095]. No sign, whitespace, fraction or exponent.

process.description: Admit static PNG or bounded 8-bit baseline/progressive Huffman JPEG by signature. JPEG supports preserve/gray with opt-in I01; bw and protection masks retain their grayscale PNG contracts. All PNG paths reject animation and trailing container bytes; binary processing retains stored grayscale samples.

verify.description: Validate the complete supported run record, closed artifact inventory and observable PNG properties without executing the recorded request.

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Paths must be well-formed UTF-8 and are never normalized or repaired. Relative effects bind to the operation's initial working directory; reported spelling is retained. Windows drive-relative publication paths are rejected. Parent must exist. Publish result.png into a new directory only after complete processing. Existing destinations are never replaced.

options.name: --output-mode
options.description: Preserve keeps the decoded gray/color category, not source bytes, ICC space, metadata or alpha. Continuous output has no enhancement filter and is verified before publication. Gray converts linear luminance; bw explicitly activates stored-sample binarization. JPEG input supports preserve/gray only; bw requires grayscale PNG.

options.name: --bit-depth
options.description: Continuous output only. Auto retains 16-bit source precision, otherwise 8. Explicit 16-to-8 reduction is reported; no precision fallback is used for resource limits.

options.name: --alpha
options.description: Continuous output only. Composite straight PNG alpha over white or black in linear light; reject refuses any non-opaque pixel. Output is opaque.

options.name: --profile-policy
options.description: Continuous output only. Interpret supported cICP, compatible ICC, sRGB or gAMA/cHRM; otherwise report an sRGB assumption. srgb explicitly overrides color declarations, not integrity or orientation checks. Unsupported HDR/cICP is rejected by embedded policy.

options.name: --binarize
options.description: Requires explicit --output-mode bw. B02/B03 use stored 1/2/4/8-bit grayscale PNG samples without transparency and output 8-bit black/white; no color or gamma conversion is applied.

options.name: --fixed-threshold
options.description: B03 only. Normalized grayscale threshold; black iff sample/255 <= T. Rejected for Sauvola.

options.name: --sauvola-window
options.description: B02 only. Centered square window with REFLECT_101 borders; a singleton dimension repeats its sample.

options.name: --sauvola-k
options.description: B02 only. Weight in T=m*(1+k*(s/(255*R)-1)), using population standard deviation in stored byte units.

options.name: --sauvola-r
options.description: B02 only. Normalized deviation scale: 0.5 means 127.5 in byte units, not 128. Black iff sample <= T; no threshold rounding or clipping.

options.name: --json
options.description: Render one JSON response on stdout and no diagnostic text on stderr. Flush the selected stream before returning. JSON exit_code describes the rendered command outcome; response-delivery failure can instead end the process with exit 5. Check both the response and process status. A missing/incomplete response or exit 5 does not prove that publication did not commit; do not retry blindly.

options.name: --help
options.description: Renders help and exits without opening input or creating output.

options.name: --version
options.description: Human-readable alias of `version`.

options.name: --illumination
options.description: Select explicit I01 surface or I02 morphological illumination for continuous preserve/gray. Auto remains I01 only.

options.name: --background-strength
options.description: Exponent applied to the illumination gain; 1 corrects the fitted background fully within the gain cap. Zero is an exact photometric no-op after parameter and mask validation.

options.name: --background-max-gain
options.description: Maximum illumination multiplicative gain. One is an exact photometric no-op.

options.name: --background-target
options.description: Linear-light target. Source uses the fitted background nearest-rank 90th percentile, not forced paper white.

options.name: --background-cell
options.description: Cell edge in oriented pixels. Auto is round(min(width,height)/24), clamped to [16,256]. Resource refusal never changes this value.

options.name: --background-quantile
options.description: Nearest-rank quantile of all eligible cell samples; protected samples are excluded.

options.name: --background-smooth
options.description: Positive grid-Laplacian weight for fitting the logarithmic background.

options.name: --background-radius
options.description: Square closing radius in oriented pixels. Auto rounds min(width,height)/50 and clamps to [8,128]; Gaussian sigma=max(0.5,radius/2).

options.name: --protect-mask
options.description: 1-bit or 8-bit grayscale PNG mask matching oriented source dimensions. Nonzero protects. Any alpha must be fully opaque; mask orientation must be normal. The mask is validated even when illumination and denoising are disabled.

options.name: --denoise
options.description: Explicit NLM-L1 or full-field floating-point TV-L1 for continuous PNG/JPEG/TIFF after illumination. No binary denoising.

options.name: --denoise-blend
options.description: Blend once in perceptual luminance; zero preserves entering samples after source/mask validation.

options.name: --nlm-h
options.description: NLM only. Equivalent 8-bit perceptual strength; native float strength is 257 times float(H). Higher strengths may remove marks.

options.name: --nlm-patch
options.description: NLM only. Square patch width.

options.name: --nlm-search
options.description: NLM only. Search at least patch; active processing requires fit in smaller oriented dimension.

options.name: --tv-lambda
options.description: TV-L1 only. L1 fidelity weight; larger values mean less smoothing.

options.name: --tv-iterations
options.description: TV-L1 only. Iteration cap; exhaustion retains a usable iterate and emits W_TV_ITERATION_LIMIT.

options.name: --tv-tolerance
options.description: TV-L1 only. Both primal and dual update tolerances at two consecutive ten-iteration checkpoints, starting at iteration 20.

options.name: --contrast
options.description: Explicit levels, gamma or CLAHE on continuous PNG/JPEG/TIFF after illumination and denoising.

options.name: --contrast-blend
options.description: Blend once in perceptual luminance. Zero retains entering samples after source/mask validation.

options.name: --levels-low
options.description: Levels only. Nearest-rank lower percentile among all unprotected perceptual samples.

options.name: --levels-high
options.description: Levels only. Nearest-rank upper percentile, greater than low. A range below 1e-6 retains exact entering RGB.

options.name: --gamma
options.description: Gamma only. f_new=f^G; above one darkens midtones. Endpoints and gamma one are exact identities.

options.name: --clahe-grid
options.description: CLAHE contextual columns and rows. Every tile must be at least 16 pixels in each direction.

options.name: --clahe-clip
options.description: CLAHE pre-redistribution clip multiplier relative to average eligible occupancy.
